metadata.description: 6-Max Cash, 100bb. BTN opens to 2.5bb, SB folds, Hero is in the BB. 3-bet to 11bb, call 1.5bb more, or fold.

source.detail: Hand-authored from standard 6-max 100bb preflop theory. NOT solver output - these are reasonable reference ranges, not an equilibrium. Replace with solver exports when available.

spec.RAISE: 99+, AJs+, AJo+, KQs, KJs, QJs, JTs, A5s-A2s, K9s-K7s, Q9s, J9s, T8s, 97s, 86s, 75s, 65s, 54s

explanations.RAISE: The Button opens around 45%, so we 3-bet a wide polarised range: value hands that are ahead of that range, and suited bluffs that block it. Letting a 45% range see a cheap flop in position is the single biggest Big Blind mistake.
explanations.CALL: Getting 3.5-to-1 closing the action against the widest range at the table. Over half of all hands are a profitable continue here - folding too much is a far bigger leak than calling slightly too wide.
explanations.FOLD: Only the genuinely unplayable hands: offsuit, disconnected, and low. Everything else has enough equity at this price.
